HEALTH-001.why: The live :8031 surface publishes per-wallet staleness, but against the ROW'S OWN declared bound (stale > HL_LIVE_WS_STALE_MS = 30000 flagged) the published flag is wrong. In one sample 4 of 10 wallets exceeded 30000ms of silence and ZERO were flagged stale:true, including one wallet silent for 2,540,339ms (~42 min) with stale=false. Cause is a threshold mismatch in the live core: HL_Live_Copy_Service_Core.py uses HL_LIVE_WS_WALLET_STALE_MS default 120000 (and HL_LIVE_WS_SUBSCRIBED_STALE_MS default 4h), not the declared 30000. Per-wallet reconnect count is also not exposed per wallet (only ws_summary.total_reconnect_count, observed 0).
